prompt: Jessica has already implemented DNSSEC and now wants to ensure that only valid TLS certificates are used by clients connecting to her web services. Which DNS-based security mechanism should she consider implementing next?
explanation: DANE (DNS-based Authentication of Named Entities) allows administrators to specify which TLS certificate is valid for a specific service in their domain by using the DNS system, protected by DNSSEC. This ensures clients connect using only valid and specified certificates.
